conditions.readers: Two concurrent persistent processes, strictly sequential request execution
conditions.index: Same immutable explicitly supplied index for both readers; format compatibility required
conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled; first request and additional warmups excluded; NOT cold-cache
conditions.ordering: Seeded balanced alternating AB/BA pair order, at most one extra first position
conditions.first_request: Each service starts immediately before its first request; remaining startup included
conditions.wall: Client write/flush to complete response line; JSON parsing excluded
conditions.engine: Unprofiled response metrics.seconds; internal wall time, NOT CPU time
conditions.correctness: Exact count-only result fields compared between readers and on every exchange
conditions.scope: No positions, ranking, snippets, full per-file oracle, CPU or RSS claim in this harness
conditions.resources: Both processes remain resident; use isolated perf_benchmark runs for per-process CPU/RSS
conditions.threads: Each executable's default; profiles and both startup samples retained separately
